description: Switch tool surface. 'configure' (default) = entry CRUD + module design tools and design resources. 'runtime' = entry CRUD plus get_module_schema (available in every mode). 'frontend' = configure + the inistate://frontend-guide resource (REST reference for building Vue/React UIs that call the Inistate API directly) — use it when the user wants a custom UI. The tool/resource list refreshes via list_changed after this call.
name: switch_mode
